remarks:
Welcome home to this well-loved single-family home in Lackawanna’s Fourth Ward! Proudly owned by the same family since it was built, this home offers a wonderful opportunity to make it your own while enjoying the charm and solid construction of a longtime family residence.

Generously sized bedrooms provide plenty of space and flexibility for family, guests, or a home office. The partially finished basement offers additional living and entertaining space, complete with a bar area that makes it the perfect spot for hosting family and friends, a game room, or a cozy secondary gathering space.

Enjoy relaxing or entertaining outdoors on the covered back patio, offering a comfortable space to enjoy the backyard in any season. The property also features a 2-car garage, providing ample room for parking, storage, and hobbies.

A brand-new furnace provides peace of mind and a valuable recent update for the next owner.

Situated in Lackawanna’s Fourth Ward, this home is conveniently located near local schools, shopping, restaurants, parks, and major roadways.

After nearly six decades of single-family ownership, this home is ready for its next chapter. With generous living spaces, a partially finished basement with bar, 2-car garage, covered back patio, and brand-new furnace, this is an opportunity you won't want to miss.
